Paper accepted for NPAR 2011

The paper "Image and Video Abstraction by Multi-scale Anisotropic Kuwahara Filtering" by Jan Eric Kyprianidis has been accepted as a contribution to the 9th Symposium on Non-Photorealistic Animation and Rendering (NPAR). The conference will be held from the 5th to 7th August in Vancouver (Canada) and is co-located with SIGGRAPH 2011.
